_comment: leanSphincs-s KAT set C (LEAKED). Generated by packages/pq-signer/rust/examples/gen_lean_vectors.rs. Positive vectors: verify(pk, digest, sig) == true for IPQVerifier/LeanSphincsSVerifier (pk = P16||root16) and LeanSphincsSAsm.verify(pkSeed, pkRoot, digest, sig) (high-aligned bytes32 words given as pkSeed/pkRoot). Keys are Light tier (kept subtree b = 13). Signatures are hedged with the given entropy (R_0 = Th(P, address(RANDOMIZER), S || digest || entropy), then upstream's grind), so re-signing reproduces them. Negative recipes apply to every positive vector and must return false (adapter) without reverting, except where 'verifierReverts' is true (raw LeanSphincsSAsm reverts on length != 4164).
derivation: role_key = HMAC-SHA512(key = 'leaked/v1/' || schemeId(32 raw bytes) || '/' || role || '/' || chainScope, msg = BIP-39 seed); S = role_key[0:32]; P = Th(0^16, address(PARAMETER), S); root per spec §9 with b = 13

negative.note: little-endian uint32 WOTS+C counter; the target-sum check (or the root) fails
